salestaxtab.everywhereYouCollectSalesTax.en:
Everywhere you collect sales tax — state, county, city, special district.
          Tag invoices with a jurisdiction and this page tells you what you owe, where.
salestaxtab.everywhereYouCollectSalesTax.draft:
Yonke indawo wena collect ukuthengisa intela — isifundazwe, county, idolobha, special district.
  Ithegi ama-invoyisi ne igunya futhi lokhu ikhasi tells wena ini wena owe, kuphi.

salestaxtab.noJurisdictionsYetAddTheFirs.en: No jurisdictions yet. Add the first place you collect sales tax.
salestaxtab.noJurisdictionsYetAddTheFirs.draft: Hhayi jurisdictions okwamanje. Nezela okuqala place wena collect ukuthengisa intela.

salestaxtab.ofSalesTaxIsnTTagged.en:
of sales tax isn't tagged to a jurisdiction yet.
            Tag invoices with a jurisdiction so every dollar lands in the right bucket.
salestaxtab.ofSalesTaxIsnTTagged.draft:
ka ukuthengisa intela akusi tagged kuya igunya okwamanje.
  Ithegi ama-invoyisi ne igunya ngakho-ke njalo dollar lands ku kwesokudla isigaba.

teaminvites.inviteYourAccountantOrTaxPro.en:
Invite your accountant or tax pro — they join with the right permissions
        and can switch between all the workspaces they serve.
teaminvites.inviteYourAccountantOrTaxPro.draft:
Isimemo yakho umgcini mabhuku noma intela ochwepheshe — bona joyina ne kwesokudla izimvume
  futhi ngakwazi shintsha phakathi konke izindawo zokusebenza bona serve.

cpapackage.mileageLogWithIRSRatesApplied.en: Mileage log with IRS rates applied
cpapackage.mileageLogWithIRSRatesApplied.draft: Ibanga irekhodi ne IRS amanani applied

customers.deleteConfirm.en: Delete customer "{{name}}"? Their invoices and statements stay on record.
customers.deleteConfirm.draft: Susa ikhasimende "{{name}}"? Kubo ama-invoyisi futhi izitatimende hlala kuvuliwe rekhoda.

payroll.partnershipStubWhenAProviderIs.en: Partnership stub: when a provider is connected, runs here will hand off tax filing and direct deposit automatically.
payroll.partnershipStubWhenAProviderIs.draft: Ubudlelwano isiphunzi: nini umnikezeli ngu okuxhunyiwe, qhuba lapha zo isandla kuvaliwe intela ukufayila futhi ngqo idiphozithi ngokuzenzakalela.

tax.inTheRepoNoIRSFiling.en: in the repo. No IRS filing is ever done in-house.
tax.inTheRepoNoIRSFiling.draft: ku repo. Hhayi IRS ukufayila ngu ke okuqediwe in-house.

tax.recipientBox1DataShapedFor.en: Recipient + Box 1 data shaped for e-filing. Tax IDs stay masked — reveal needs PII access. Draft data only, nothing is filed in-house.
tax.recipientBox1DataShapedFor.draft: Ummukeli + Box 1 idatha shaped kwa e-filing. Intela IDs hlala masked — reveal needs PII ukufinyelela. Okusalungiswa idatha kuphela, lutho ngu filed in-house.

tax.thisDraftLivesInTaxBanditsReview.en: This draft lives in TaxBandits — review and Transmit there to file with the IRS. This app never files in-house.
tax.thisDraftLivesInTaxBanditsReview.draft: Lokhu okusalungiswa lives ku TaxBandits — buyekeza futhi Transmit there kuya ifayela ne IRS. Lokhu uhlelo angisoze amafayela in-house.

tax.NECIsRequiredForNon.en: 1099-NEC is required for non-corporate contractors paid ≥
tax.NECIsRequiredForNon.draft: 1099-NEC ngu okudingekayo kwa non-corporate osonkontileka okukhokhiwe ≥

tax.inTheYearEFilingCreates.en: in the year. E-filing creates a draft in TaxBandits — you review and transmit there. This app never files with the IRS directly.
tax.inTheYearEFilingCreates.draft: ku unyaka. E-filing creates okusalungiswa ku TaxBandits — wena buyekeza futhi transmit there. Lokhu uhlelo angisoze amafayela ne IRS directly.
